# Fishing: Guide & data mining of all fish & axolotls

[Update 04/08/2026] Weather control stations updated

[Update 03/01/2026] Added Alien Weather Control Station

**Fishing** is the big theme of Season 21 in Fallout 76. In principle, you can cast your fishing rod in every small body of water in Appalachia. There are various **fishing rods**, **bait, hooks** and **floats** that can be used to optimize fishing.

Depending on the **area** you can fish for different **fish**. The better the **bait**, the higher the chance of **rare fish**. And the **weather** also plays a role. The rarest catch is **Axolotl**, they are very rare and it is only possible to catch one variant per month.

In addition, there are lots of new challenges as well as a quest and a daily with **many new rewards**.

### Index

## New quest "Let off the leash!"

In order to **unlock fishing** you have to complete the new quest “Cast off the line!” go through. You will speak to Captain Raymond Clark at the **new location Anglers Ruh**. Your task is then to catch a few fish and cook fish snacks. Fishing is unlocked during the quest. After the quest, the new daily is also available for you. Numerous new rewards await you here.

## New location “Anglers Ruh”

The new location Anglers Ruh is located right next to Valley Galleria in the far east of Appalachia.

In this location you will find 3 new NPCs:

**Linda Lee:** Giant hermit crab and pet of the "Fisherman". If you give her fish bites and she is hungry, you can receive legendary weapons, armor and power armor as a reward (1-3 stars). **Only give away 25 fish bites at a time** to get legendary items and not waste your fish bites.

**The Fisherman:** Silent, strange "fish person" who likes to sharpen his knives. Here you can buy ordinary bait for fishing

**Captain Raymond Clark:** The old sailor is the most talkative of the 3 NPCs, he gives you tasks in the new quest and also provides you with the new daily. You can also buy ordinary fishing bait from him.

## This is how fishing works in Fallout 76

You stand next to a body of water. If you now look at the water, you will get a new option for casting the fishing rod. Hold down the fishing button and you are in fishing mode. You can change the view here. Change the bait and cast the fishing rod.

## Bait types

There are 3 types of lures: Ordinary, Enhanced and Super

**Common Bait** can be obtained from Captain Raymond Clark and the Fisherman, as well as from new collectors in your camp

**Improved Lures** can be obtained from the following activities: **All public events** as well as endgame events such as Cryptic, Scorched Earth (Queen), A Colossal Problem (Earle Wiliams), Seismic Activity (Ultacite Titan), Neurological Warfare and also from the **Caravans** in Milestone Zero.

**First-class bait** is only available in season. Possibly later in the Atom Shop. So be careful with it.

## Fishing rod improvements

You now always have your fishing rod with you. However, you can't find them in your inventory
